description: Issue #286: the check tree exposes ranked options, removes empty children and seals erasure.
grammar:
%rule text kept empty ignored
%conditions $ ≅ #·text⁅ kept empty ignored ⁆
%rule kept ("a" ≻ "b") :: ∅
%rule empty (ε ≻ "x") :: ∅
%rule ignored ("c" ≻ "d") :: ∅
%erased
%check root
 #·text⁅ kept⁅ "a" ⁆ ignored⁅ ⋯ ⁆ ⁆
%warning "tree"
%check leaf
 #·_
%warning $.terminal
%check removed
 #·empty
%warning "bad"
%check erased-root
 #·ignored
%warning "bad"
